description: Printful catalog linkage and print specification for a product. Written by the app under $app.printful.

catalog_product_id.description: Printful catalog product this Swell product was synced from

catalog_variant_id.description: Printful catalog variant this product prints on, mirrored for reference. The mapping the code follows lives on apps/printful/catalog-items.variant_id

technique.description: Print technique used for costing and order items (e.g. dtg, embroidery)

placements.description: Print placements submitted with each order item

placement.description: Printful placement id (e.g. front, back, embroidery_chest_left)

artwork_url.description: Publicly reachable print file for this placement. Required: a placement listed with no file is not printed, and Printful still produces and charges for the garment

artwork_hash.description: Content hash of the print file, carried in the URL so Printful does not reuse a stale file

print_area.description: Printable geometry from the catalog mockup styles, used to size artwork

dpi.description: Print resolution reported by Printful for this product

artwork_url.description: Print file used when the product has a single placement

artwork_hash.description: Content hash of artwork_url. Printful dedupes print files by URL and will not refetch a URL it has already seen, so the hash must appear in the URL
